items.q: When Jack gave me the album, I took that money and moved

ctx.x: Okay. It’ll come to you. So you guys must have had a grand time at that point. He was soaking . . .

Juanita at that time was – okay. When Jack gave me the album, I took that money and moved – we moved – Juanita and I moved out and moved to the place in the Village. This must have – yeah, okay. Juanita had to be there, in the room with Bill, the
one-room apartment. She had to be a part of it. But when I moved out, it was with Juanita too, but she didn’t stay long, because she and Jimmy had a thing. We still . . .
